verdicts.note: Mountain town along a fast river with bridges, houses on the slopes: the valley settlement itself, no monument shown.

verdicts.file: Balo Kale Stupa Swat Valley Pakistan.jpg
verdicts.note: Brick stupa with a dome standing on terraced stone foundations in the valley: a Buddhist monument within the site region.

verdicts.file: The remains of the Hindu Shahi Tower next to Amlukdara Stupa, Swat Valley Pakistan.jpg
verdicts.note: Ruined brick and stone walls beside an excavated pit in the valley floor: remains of a tower monument in the region.
Snowy slope with pine trees overlooking a valley village: pure mountain landscape, no structures of the site.

verdicts.file: Dome of the Amluk Dara Stupa, Swat Valley, Pakistan.jpg
verdicts.note: Close view of a large brick stupa dome on a stone base with valley slopes behind: the stupa monument itself.
Turquoise alpine lake among barren scree slopes: high mountain landscape, no archaeological structure.
Wider view of the same turquoise lake with a hiker in the foreground: mountain scenery only.
Modern road scene with a bronze equestrian statue on a plinth, a hotel sign and a soldier walking: contemporary monument, not the valley's sites.

verdicts.file: The Chitral campaign - a narrative of events in Chitral, Swat, and Bajour (1895) (14778483291).jpg
verdicts.note: Vintage halftone book print of hills above a riverbed with scattered huts: period landscape, no site structure identifiable.
Panorama of terraced, partly snow-covered mountains and forested ridges: the valley's landscape only.
